winner.text: Replace pointwise BCE training with within-user pairwise logistic ranking loss using one positive-negative pair per eligible training user batch.
winner.rationale: The official objective is within-user ordering, whereas the current model is trained pointwise. The gap between useful global ordering and weak top-five slices makes an ordering-aligned objective a high-information alternative, though sparse users may provide few valid pairs.
winner.exact_ablation: Replace only BCE with pairwise logistic loss over sampled same-user positive-negative pairs; preserve the FM architecture, seven fields, optimizer, split, pair construction cutoff, and evaluation code.

expected_effect.GAUC: Moderate positive increase, approximately +0.003 to +0.009, because optimization directly rewards positive-over-negative ordering within users.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: Small positive or flat change, approximately -0.001 to +0.005; pair sampling may improve broad ordering without reliably improving the first five positions.

selection_rationale: Select c03 because it directly aligns training with the official within-user ranking metrics, offers the strongest expected GAUC gain (+0.003 to +0.009; expected primary gain 0.004), and is ranked first by the Consultant (utility 0.78). It is a tightly controlled single-component ablation with low leakage risk and stronger upside than safer but smaller representation or capacity changes. The main downside is medium runtime risk and limited pair availability for sparse users, which should be monitored during evaluation.
